messages.subject: toggle class of input
parts:
Say I've model A and model B. When a input (call it input1_A) of model A is changed, the input1_B of model B also changes if it is in "non-active state". If input1_B is altered its state changes to "active" and it will no longer be bound to input1_A.

Here's a working example https://rokka.shinyapps.io/smartep  

But, now I want input1_B to show its state by changing its background-color. I think this could be done with javascript and css, I just don't know how.

Say I include a css like .nonActive { backround-color: grey }

If I add "nonActive" to inputB's class when it's non-active and remove it when it's active it should work (at least it works when I manually add the nonActive class in the browser). But how do I do that from shiny?


Regards,
Lukas Lundström

messages.author: c2be02cf0a402f59
messages.subject: Re: toggle class of input
parts:
Turns out that shinyjs::toggleClass is exactly what I was looking for. Problem solved.

Regards,
Lukas Lundström
